Focus: Defensive fortifications, crafting, and siege warfare.

Sendo engineers read battlefields as structures to raise, break, seal, or redirect, making craft and fuinjutsu part of the same doctrine.

Village: Kanigakure

Clan: Sendo

Bonus Feat: Siege Engineer

Starting Techniques:

  • Kenjutsu: Urashamen-uchi
  • Shinheki no Jutsu
  • Chakra no Hikari
